## Review of tests/loans.robot and tests/loan_steps.resource

### S2 (layering)
- L1 — tests/loans.robot:8 — `Register Member` and `Add Book` are library calls in the test body; move them into Given steps such as `Given Mia is a standard member`.
- L2 — tests/loans.robot:11 — "opens the catalogue and selects book1 and presses borrow" scripts the UI; write the intent: `When Mia borrows "Dune"`.
- L6 — tests/loans.robot:20 — "Check stuff" has a second When/Then phase; split it into two tests.

### S3 (language)
- W1 — tests/loans.robot:10 — "user1 is registered and the library has book1" sets two facts in one step; split it into two Given/And steps.
- W2 — tests/loans.robot:12 — "Then everything is fine" names nothing observable (and its keyword only logs, C5); state the loan outcome.
- W3 — tests/loans.robot:8 — `user1` and `book1` are placeholders; use a member name and a real title.
- W12 — tests/loans.robot:7 — "Test loan 1" and "Check stuff" describe nothing; name the behaviour.
- W6 — tests/loans.robot:1 — no suite Documentation, no `Metadata    Feature` and no feature: tag.

Summary: 3 layering and 5 language findings; no files were changed.
